title: Spicy Korean-Style Bibimbap
description: A flavorful and nutritious Korean-inspired bibimbap recipe with energizing ingredients to start your day.

ingredients.name: Cauliflower Rice
ingredients.notes: Use pre-cut cauliflower rice for convenience

ingredients.name: Prunes
ingredients.notes: Rehydrate by soaking in water for 10 minutes

ingredients.name: Bibimbap Sauce (make your own or store-bought)
ingredients.notes: Homemade recipe: 1/2 cup rice vinegar, 1/4 cup sugar, 2 tsp Gochujang

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables (e.g., carrots, zucchini, spinach)
ingredients.notes: Use leftover or pre-cut for convenience

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce (optional)
ingredients.notes: Use gluten-free soy sauce for vegan option

instructions: Prepare the cauliflower rice according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together Korean chili flakes and sesame oil. Set aside.
Soak the prunes in water for 10 minutes, then chop into small pieces.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
In a separate pan, warm the bibimbap sauce over low heat.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of cauliflower rice onto a plate, followed by the cooked vegetables and chopped prunes.
Drizzle the bibimbap sauce over the top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Finally, sprinkle the Korean chili flake mixture over the dish and serve immediately.
For added energy, sprinkle some energizing powder on top (optional).
